views.markdown: Apple Music, iOS 26 style. A small glass now-playing pill (swipe to skip, scrolling title) that collapses with the tab bar, iOS 26 album, artist, search and library pages, star favorites, glass top buttons, animated album covers in the player and more. For iOS 15 and 16, every iPhone (A11 and newer). Tested on iPhone 13 Pro Max, iOS 16. Made by nano.
Title swipe really gets the touch now (it was checking the wrong window)
Title swipe listens on the whole window (it never got the touch before)
Title swipe fixed (the player's own scroll gesture was taking it first)
Swipe the song title on the player left for the next song or right for the previous one (the title follows your finger); new setting "Swipe Title to Skip"
Animated Album Covers is off by default (turn it on in MusicPill settings)

No more wrong animated covers: covers are no longer guessed from the album page's song list (it also lists other albums), a tie only happens when you press Play / a song on that same album page while it's on screen. Saved covers are cleared once more.

Animated covers made safer and lighter: the cover video pauses when the player is closed or Music is in the background, an expired saved cover is forgotten instead of showing black, text reading never touches freed objects, fewer page scans, and memory is freed on low memory

A song that changes by itself (autoplay / next song) no longer takes the previous album's animated cover; a cover is only tied to an album when you tap Play or a song on that album's page. Old saved covers are cleared once.
New setting "Animated Album Covers": a cover found once is saved and plays in the player every time after; turning it off deletes the saved covers
Animated album covers play in the player again (the album title is read better, and hitting Play on an album page ties its cover to that song)
Dark mode switch titles stay (the title segments were being hidden as if they were backgrounds).
Library title always shows (switch laid out again after narrowing), glass switch in dark mode too, faster drop animation.
Both Apple Music / Library titles show (plain colour per mode), the switch leaves as a liquid drop into the X and comes back out of it.

Light mode: frosted glass with a visible rim and soft shadow, back button no longer dark, queue bar white with Increase Contrast, search switch drawn by iOS (both titles show), liquid drop on tapping search.
Apple Music / Library switch in light mode: white selected pill on a faint grey track (was black).
Fixes the crash on launch in 1.2.9/1.2.10 (the light/dark glass colour called itself forever).
Fixes 1.2.9 freezing / closing Music (light-mode colours were re-set in a loop).
Player Colors setting (Automatic / Pink / White); light mode: clear frosted glass with dark icons, readable text, light status blur.
Follows Increase Contrast: off = white star, Music's own artist colour, see-through queue pill row; on = pink accents, black row (as before).
Hooks on Music's own button classes retry until they exist (cold start after a reboot).
Animated cover stops when the next song is from another album (song info refreshed while the player is open, old video dropped on change).
Animated cover also matched by the playing song's title on the album page; Lossless badge back to Music's own (no glass).
Animated cover matched to its album by the header text Music draws itself (no labels after a reboot meant no match).
Animated cover: only the album's own header video is taken (a music video tile elsewhere was picked before), remembered per album.
An album / artist share button no longer stays behind on Library.
Player ••• / Lossless / album download found by symbol and text too (VoiceOver labels are empty after a reboot, which broke them).
Public release: package id com.nano.musicpill (replaces com.user.musicpill).
Rootless and rootful packages kept apart (1.1.0 published the rootful one by mistake).
Release build: arm64 + arm64e (every iPhone that runs iOS 16), rootless and rootful packages, works on iOS 15.0 - 16.x.
The account picture was taken for an album's download button and hidden for good; our own buttons are skipped and un-hidden now.
